description: This file defines the FileContextTracker class responsible for tracking file operations, modifications, and context management within a project, specifically for handling stale context detection and updates in a VSCode extension environment.

classes.name: FileContextTracker
classes.description: A class for tracking file operations, managing file watchers, and updating task metadata to prevent stale context in a VSCode extension.

methods.name: getCwd
methods.description: Retrieves the current workspace directory path.

methods.name: setupFileWatcher
methods.description: Sets up a file system watcher for a specific file if not already existing.

methods.name: trackFileContext
methods.description: Main method to track a file operation and set up watchers, called when a file is passed to Roo.

methods.name: getContextProxy
methods.description: Retrieves the ContextProxy object from the provider reference.

methods.name: saveTaskMetadata
methods.description: Saves task metadata to storage and posts message to webview.

methods.name: addFileToFileContextTracker
methods.description: Updates metadata with file status, read/edit dates, and manages stale/active states.

methods.name: getAndClearRecentlyModifiedFiles
methods.description: Returns and clears the set of recently modified files.

methods.name: getAndClearCheckpointPossibleFile
methods.description: Returns and clears the set of files marked for checkpoint.

methods.name: markFileAsEditedByRoo
methods.description: Marks a file as edited by Roo to prevent false positives.
